All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Red Hat build of OpenTelemetry 3.11.1 has been released", "title": "Topic"}, {"category": "general", "text": "This release of the Red Hat build of OpenTelemetry provides new features, security improvements, and bug fixes.


Breaking changes:

* None


Deprecations:

* None


Technology Preview features:

* None


Enhancements:

* None


Bug fixes:

* Before this update, the Collector used a bare service name (`http://<name>-targetallocator:80`) to contact the Target Allocator, which did not match the standard `NO_PROXY=.svc` entry. As a consequence, on clusters behind a corporate HTTP proxy, the request was routed through the proxy, which returned an HTML authentication page instead of the expected JSON response, breaking the metrics scraping pipeline. With this release, the Target Allocator endpoint uses the FQDN (`http://<name>-targetallocator.<namespace>.svc:80`). As a result, the Collector reaches the Target Allocator directly without routing through the proxy. For more information, see https://issues.redhat.com/browse/TRACING-6784.
